bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' >/dev/null || exit 72
found=0
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /mnt/gdrive /media/g /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage; do
  if test -d "$p"; then
    candidate="$(find "$p" -maxdepth 7 -type f -size +1300M -size -2000M -print -quit 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if test -n "$candidate"; then found=1; break; fi
  fi
done
if test "$found" = 1; then echo ORIGINAL_LARGE_VIDEO_PRESENT; exit 0; else echo ORIGINAL_LARGE_VIDEO_NOT_FOUND_IN_SCANNED_ROOTS; exit 71; fi
